hannah: heads-up: product decided to deprecate v1 endpoints (models/generate/chat) on 2026-07-01. we need a short migration playbook + quick snippets for Go and Ruby, plus runbook for support.
simon: ack. i'll draft Go and curl examples. quick ask: include a tiny unit test example that asserts request shape against v2 signature. helps customers validate.
anya: i'm updating the migration guide structure now. will add a section: 'compat shim patterns' and 'console model-swap UX notes'. pushing a docs PR shortly.
ben: link fixes: the SDK change log link still points to /sdk/v1. i have a redirect PR ready for the docs site. also update the include that references old sample app repo.
kira: FYI support needs a one-pager for common errors post-migration (401, 422 on model param, 5xx routing). ben, can you add examples of error responses?
simon: Go snippet (paste): ```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
)
func main() {
  body := []byte(`{"model":"redwood/gpt-4-mini","input":"Summarize: ..."}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + "REPLACE_WITH_ENV")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  fmt.Println("status:", resp.Status)
}
```
hannah: perfect, simon. add a comment about checking 429/503 and falling back to a smaller model alias.
anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/259 1 - added sections: quick migration checklist, SDK upgrade matrix, sample Go/Ruby snippets, and a support FAQ. staging preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/migrations/v1-deprecate
ben: added sample error JSONs to the support FAQ. example: `{"error":{"code":"invalid_model","message":"model parameter unknown"}}`
kira: thanks. i'll draft the support one-pager and pair with ben to add triage labels for customers who hit invalid_model. also will schedule a 30-min training session for CS on 2026-05-25.
simon: small doc nit: the console screenshot for model swap uses dropdown label "fallback" but product renamed it to "fast-fallback" — update before merge.
anya: good catch, fixed in PR. also added a minimal canary checklist: 1) update SDK on canary flag 2) run smoke tests 3) monitor latency + error rates 4) rollback plan with route aliasing.
hannah: comms plan: send an email to active customers on 2026-05-22, blog post same day, in-product banner week of 2026-05-26. kevin from comms will finalize copy. kira please confirm support readiness by 2026-05-20.
ben: link redirect PR merged to staging. docs-bot: auto-deploy preview with PR 259 and redirect changes: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/migrations/v1-deprecate (preview TTL 48h).
docs-bot: note: preview contains live code blocks; ensure secrets are not in examples.
simon: merged quick Go test snippet and added header auth example.
kira: support one-pager done and uploaded to internal KB: https://internal.redwood.ai/kb/v1-deprecation-support (internal only).
anya: requesting reviews from simon + hannah. will hold merge until support confirms training completed.
